range: round-6 entries 49-60 (the plans left over from the 3.28 selection)

en: The Kingdom of Powys as a Welsh successor state, petty kingdom and principality emerging after the end of Roman rule in Britain
Its territory roughly covering the northern two-thirds of the modern county of Powys and part of the English West Midlands
zh: 波伊斯王国是罗马统治结束后出现的威尔士继承国与小王国
领土大致相当于今波伊斯郡北部三分之二与英格兰西米德兰兹部分地区

politics.zh: 波伊斯王国是罗马统治不列颠结束后出现的威尔士继承国与小王国，领土大致覆盖今波伊斯郡北部三分之二以及英格兰西米德兰兹的部分地区。它由本地王统统治，在中世纪早期是威尔士东部的主要势力，长期与英格兰的麦西亚王国争夺边界地区，12世纪后在英格兰王权与诺曼领主的压力下分裂，最终并入威尔士边区与英格兰王国。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Powys was a Welsh successor state, petty kingdom and principality that emerged after the end of Roman rule in Britain, its territory roughly covering the northern two-thirds of the modern county of Powys and part of the English West Midlands. Ruled by a local royal line, it was a leading power in eastern Wales in the early Middle Ages and long contested the borderlands with the Mercian kingdom of England; after the twelfth century it fragmented under the pressure of English royal power and Norman lords and was absorbed into the Welsh marches and the kingdom of England.

economy.zh: 王国地处塞文河上游的谷地与山地，农业与畜牧业是经济基础，位于威尔士与英格兰之间的通道上，边境市集与牲畜贸易是重要收入来源。
economy.en: The kingdom lay in the upper Severn valley and the surrounding hills, where farming and herding formed the economic base, and it stood on the routes between Wales and England, so border markets and the cattle trade were important sources of income.

culture.zh: 波伊斯保留威尔士的诗歌与法律传统，宫廷诗人享有特权，中世纪威尔士语文学与圣徒传说在此传承，罗马时期的城镇遗址如弗罗克卢姆等地留下早期城市记忆。
culture.en: Powys preserved Welsh poetic and legal tradition, court poets held privileged status, medieval Welsh literature and the lives of saints were transmitted there, and Roman towns such as Viroconium left a memory of early urban life.

events.zh: 关键节点包括5世纪罗马统治结束后的建国、7至8世纪与麦西亚的边界战争、12世纪的分裂，以及13世纪被英格兰征服后并入边区。
events.en: Key moments are the founding after Roman rule ended in the fifth century, the border wars with Mercia in the seventh and eighth centuries, the divisions of the twelfth century and its absorption into the marches after the English conquest of the thirteenth.

value.zh: 罗马统治不列颠结束后出现的威尔士继承国。
value.en: It emerged as a Welsh successor state after Roman rule ended.

value.zh: 长期与英格兰的麦西亚王国争夺边界。
value.en: It long contested the border with the Mercian kingdom.

en: The Kingdom of Burgundy, also known as the Kingdom of Arles, as a realm established in 933 by the unification of Lower Burgundy with Upper Burgundy
Its rule by monarchs from the Elder House of Welf until 1032
Its incorporation into the Holy Roman Empire in 1032 as one of the empire's constituent kingdoms
zh: 勃艮第王国又称阿尔勒王国，933年由下勃艮第与上勃艮第合并而成
1032年前由韦尔夫家族统治
1032年并入神圣罗马帝国，成为帝国构成王国之一

politics.zh: 勃艮第王国又称阿尔勒王国，是933年由下勃艮第与上勃艮第合并而成的国家，地域包括今法国东南部与瑞士西部。1032年前由韦尔夫家族统治，此后并入神圣罗马帝国，成为帝国的构成王国之一，皇帝通过地方贵族与主教间接治理；14至15世纪其地逐步被法国王室与萨伏依家族瓜分，1378年帝国正式放弃对部分地区的权力。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Burgundy, also known as the Kingdom of Arles, was a realm established in 933 by the unification of Lower Burgundy with Upper Burgundy, covering what is now south-eastern France and western Switzerland. It was ruled by monarchs from the Elder House of Welf until 1032, when it was incorporated into the Holy Roman Empire as one of its constituent kingdoms, the emperor governing indirectly through local nobles and bishops; in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries France and Savoy divided its lands, and in 1378 the empire formally gave up its rights over part of them.

economy.zh: 王国地处罗讷河走廊，控制阿尔卑斯山口与地中海沿岸港口，农业、葡萄酒与过境贸易是经济基础，里昂、阿尔勒与日内瓦是商业与宗教中心。
economy.en: The kingdom lay on the Rhone corridor, controlling the Alpine passes and the Mediterranean ports; farming, wine and transit trade formed the economic base, and Lyon, Arles and Geneva were centres of commerce and religion.

culture.zh: 阿尔勒王国是罗曼式建筑与骑士文化的重要区域，修道院与主教座堂留下大量建筑遗产，奥克语与法兰克-普罗旺斯语在此通行，宫廷赞助诗歌与编年史。
culture.en: The Kingdom of Arles was an important region of Romanesque architecture and chivalric culture, its monasteries and cathedrals left a rich architectural heritage, Occitan and Franco-Provencal were spoken there, and its courts patronised poetry and chronicles.

events.zh: 关键节点包括933年两国合并、1032年并入神圣罗马帝国、13至14世纪法国王室的渗透，以及1378年后帝国放弃对该地区的权利。
events.en: Key moments are the union of the two Burgundies in 933, its incorporation into the Holy Roman Empire in 1032, the penetration of the French crown in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries and the empire's renunciation of its rights after 1378.

value.zh: 933年上下勃艮第合并为勃艮第王国。
value.en: Upper and Lower Burgundy were united in 933.

value.zh: 1032年并入神圣罗马帝国。
value.en: It was incorporated into the Holy Roman Empire in 1032.

en: The Grand Duchy of Lithuania as a sovereign state in north-eastern Europe from the thirteenth century to the late eighteenth
Its foundation by Lithuanians who were at the time a polytheistic people
Its suppression during the 1795 partitions of Poland-Lithuania
zh: 立陶宛大公国是13世纪至18世纪末东北欧的主权国家
由当时尚信奉多神教的立陶宛人建立
1795年波兰-立陶宛瓜分时被撤销

politics.zh: 立陶宛大公国是13世纪至18世纪末存在于东北欧的主权国家，由当时尚信奉多神教的立陶宛人建立，首都后来设在维尔纽斯。它在14世纪迅速扩张，版图从波罗的海延伸到黑海草原，1386年与波兰联合后形成波兰-立陶宛联邦；1795年第三次瓜分时被俄国吞并，国家被撤销。
politics.en: The Grand Duchy of Lithuania was a sovereign state in north-eastern Europe that existed from the thirteenth century until the late eighteenth, founded by Lithuanians who were at the time a polytheistic people, with its capital later at Vilnius. It expanded rapidly in the fourteenth century, its lands reaching from the Baltic to the Black Sea steppe, and in 1386 it entered a union with Poland that grew into the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth; in the third partition of 1795 Russia annexed it and the state was suppressed.

economy.zh: 大公国经济以农业、林业与河运贸易为基础，谷物、木材、毛皮与蜂蜜是主要出口品，涅曼河与维斯瓦河连接波罗的海市场，城市依马格德堡法获得自治。
economy.en: The grand duchy's economy rested on farming, forestry and river trade, with grain, timber, furs and honey as the main exports, the Niemen and Vistula linking it to Baltic markets, and its towns receiving self-government under Magdeburg law.

culture.zh: 立陶宛大公国是欧洲最后一个皈依基督教的国家，1387年正式受洗；境内鲁塞尼亚、波兰与犹太等社群共存，教会斯拉夫语与拉丁语用于文书，维尔纽斯成为多文化城市。
culture.en: The grand duchy was the last country in Europe to adopt Christianity, being baptised in 1387; Ruthenian, Polish and Jewish communities lived within its borders, Church Slavonic and Latin were used in documents, and Vilnius became a multi-cultural city.

events.zh: 关键节点包括13世纪建国、14世纪在格迪米纳斯与维陶塔斯时期的扩张、1386年与波兰联合、1569年卢布林合并，以及1795年被俄国吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the founding in the thirteenth century, the expansion under Gediminas and Vytautas in the fourteenth, the union with Poland in 1386, the Union of Lublin in 1569 and the Russian annexation of 1795.

value.zh: 13世纪由立陶宛人建立。
value.en: It was founded by Lithuanians in the thirteenth century.

value.zh: 1795年第三次瓜分时被俄国吞并。
value.en: Russia annexed it in the third partition of 1795.

en: The Antigonid dynasty as a Macedonian Greek royal house ruling the kingdom of Macedon in the Hellenistic period
Its foundation by Antigonus I Monophthalmus, a general and successor of Alexander the Great who came to power in the Diadochi Wars
His assumption of the title of basileus
zh: 安提柯王朝是希腊化时期统治马其顿王国的马其顿希腊王室
由亚历山大大帝的将领与继业者安提柯一世创立，他在继业者战争中掌权
并采用巴西琉斯（王）的称号

politics.zh: 安提柯王朝是希腊化时期统治马其顿王国的马其顿希腊王室，由亚历山大大帝的将领与继业者安提柯一世·独眼创立，他在继业者战争中掌权并采用巴西琉斯（王）的称号。王朝在德米特里二世与腓力五世时期与罗马共和国反复交战，前168年彼得那战役后马其顿被罗马征服并分为四个共和国，前148年成为罗马行省。
politics.en: The Antigonid dynasty was a Macedonian Greek royal house that ruled the kingdom of Macedon in the Hellenistic period, founded by Antigonus I Monophthalmus, a general and successor of Alexander the Great who came to power during the Diadochi Wars and took the title of basileus. Under Demetrius II and Philip V the dynasty fought repeatedly with the Roman Republic, and after the battle of Pydna in 168 BC Macedon was conquered and divided into four republics, becoming a Roman province in 148 BC.

economy.zh: 马其顿经济以农业、林业与矿产为基础，控制爱琴海北岸的港口与色雷斯的金矿，王室通过土地与税收维持军队，海上贸易与谷物出口是重要财源。
economy.en: The Macedonian economy rested on farming, forestry and mining, controlling the ports of the northern Aegean and the gold mines of Thrace; the crown maintained its army through land and taxation, and maritime trade and grain exports were important sources of revenue.

culture.zh: 王朝宫廷是希腊化文化的中心之一，赞助哲学家与艺术家，帕拉第乌斯等学者在此活动，马其顿的军事制度与城市规划影响地中海世界。
culture.en: The court was one of the centres of Hellenistic culture, patronising philosophers and artists, with scholars such as Perseus of Macedon's circle active there, and Macedonian military institutions and town planning influenced the Mediterranean world.

events.zh: 关键节点包括前306年前后安提柯一世称王、前3世纪与希腊城邦及罗马的战争、前197年库诺斯克法莱战役，以及前168年彼得那战役后马其顿被罗马征服。
events.en: Key moments are the assumption of the royal title by Antigonus I around 306 BC, the wars with the Greek cities and Rome in the third century, the battle of Cynoscephalae in 197 BC and the Roman conquest after the battle of Pydna in 168 BC.

value.zh: 由亚历山大的继业者安提柯一世创立。
value.en: It was founded by Antigonus I, a successor of Alexander.

value.zh: 前168年彼得那战役后马其顿被罗马征服。
value.en: Macedon was conquered by Rome after the battle of Pydna in 168 BC.

en: The Grand Principality of Moscow, before 1389 the Principality of Moscow and known by the exonym Muscovy, as a late medieval Russian monarchy
Its capital at the city of Moscow
Its origin as an appanage principality in the thirteenth century and its rise to become the leading Russian principality and a centralised state
zh: 莫斯科大公国在1389年前称莫斯科公国，外称莫斯科维亚，是晚期中世纪俄罗斯君主国
首都为莫斯科城
13世纪时为分封公国，后成为罗斯诸国中的主导力量与中央集权国家

politics.zh: 莫斯科大公国在1389年前称莫斯科公国，外称莫斯科维亚，是晚期中世纪的俄罗斯君主国，首都为莫斯科城。它最初是13世纪的一个分封公国，凭借与金帐汗国的关系、对邻近公国的兼并以及教会支持，逐步成为罗斯诸国中的主导力量；伊凡三世时期摆脱蒙古统治并统一东北罗斯，为后来的俄罗斯沙皇国奠基。
politics.en: The Grand Principality of Moscow, called the Principality of Moscow before 1389 and known by the exonym Muscovy, was a late medieval Russian monarchy with its capital at the city of Moscow. Originally an appanage principality in the thirteenth century, it used its relations with the Golden Horde, the annexation of neighbouring principalities and the support of the church to become the leading Russian principality; under Ivan III it threw off Mongol rule and unified north-eastern Rus, laying the basis of the later Tsardom of Russia.

economy.zh: 大公国经济以伏尔加河与奥卡河流域的农业、林业与毛皮贸易为基础，莫斯科位于河运与陆路的交汇处，逐步成为俄罗斯的贸易与手工业中心。
economy.en: The grand principality's economy rested on farming, forestry and the fur trade in the Volga and Oka basins, and Moscow, at the meeting point of river and land routes, gradually became the centre of Russian trade and crafts.

culture.zh: 莫斯科是俄罗斯东正教会的中心，都主教座迁至此地，克里姆林宫的教堂与修道院成为宗教与建筑中心，编年史与圣像画传统在此延续，为俄罗斯文化认同提供核心。
culture.en: Moscow was the centre of the Russian Orthodox Church once the metropolitan moved there, the churches and monasteries of the Kremlin became a focus of religion and architecture, and chronicle writing and icon painting continued, giving Russian cultural identity its core.

events.zh: 关键节点包括13世纪成为分封公国、1320年代获得大公称号、1380年库利科沃战役、1480年摆脱金帐汗国统治，以及伊凡三世时期的统一。
events.en: Key moments are its origin as an appanage in the thirteenth century, the grant of the grand princely title in the 1320s, the battle of Kulikovo in 1380, the end of Golden Horde rule in 1480 and the unification carried out under Ivan III.

value.zh: 1389年前称公国，此后称大公国。
value.en: It was a principality before 1389 and a grand principality afterwards.

value.zh: 1480年摆脱金帐汗国统治。
value.en: It ended Golden Horde rule in 1480.

en: The Nogai Horde as a confederation founded by the Nogais that occupied the Pontic-Caspian steppe from about 1500
Its displacement westwards by the Kalmyks and southwards by the Russians in the seventeenth century
The Manghud Mongol tribe as a core of the horde
zh: 诺盖汗国是诺盖人建立的联盟，约1500年起占据黑海-里海草原
17世纪被卡尔梅克人西逼、被俄国人南压
蒙古芒古特部是其核心

politics.zh: 诺盖汗国是诺盖人建立的联盟，约1500年起占据黑海-里海草原，蒙古芒古特部是其核心。它在15至16世纪控制伏尔加河与乌拉尔河之间的草原通道，与莫斯科、克里米亚汗国及中亚各汗国保持往来；17世纪在卡尔梅克人西进与俄国南扩的双重压力下分裂，部分部众西迁至多瑙河下游，其余逐渐被俄国与哈萨克汗国吸收。
politics.en: The Nogai Horde was a confederation founded by the Nogais that occupied the Pontic-Caspian steppe from about 1500, with the Mongol tribe of the Manghuds as its core. In the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries it controlled the steppe corridors between the Volga and the Urals and dealt with Moscow, the Crimean Khanate and the Central Asian khanates; in the seventeenth century it split under the pressure of the Kalmyks moving west and the Russians expanding south, part of its people migrating to the lower Danube while the rest were gradually absorbed by Russia and the Kazakh Khanate.

economy.zh: 经济以游牧畜牧为基础，马、羊与骆驼是主要财富，汗国控制草原商路并参与奴隶、牲畜与布匹贸易，与俄国及中亚城市的交换是收入来源。
economy.en: The economy rested on nomadic pastoralism, with horses, sheep and camels as the main form of wealth, and the horde controlled the steppe routes and took part in the trade in slaves, livestock and cloth, exchange with Russia and the Central Asian cities providing income.

culture.zh: 诺盖人使用钦察突厥语，口传史诗与部落谱系维系认同，伊斯兰教在草原上以松散形式传播，部落组织与汗的权威共同构成政治文化。
culture.en: The Nogais spoke Kipchak Turkic, oral epic and tribal genealogy sustained their identity, Islam spread loosely across the steppe, and tribal organisation together with the khan's authority formed their political culture. Their winter camps and summer pastures shaped the year.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15世纪末联盟形成、16世纪控制草原商路、17世纪在卡尔梅克与俄国压力下分裂，以及18世纪大部分部众被俄国与哈萨克汗国吸收。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the confederation at the end of the fifteenth century, its control of the steppe routes in the sixteenth, its division under Kalmyk and Russian pressure in the seventeenth and the absorption of most of its people by Russia and the Kazakh Khanate in the eighteenth.

value.zh: 蒙古芒古特部是其核心。
value.en: The Mongol Manghud tribe formed its core.

value.zh: 17世纪被卡尔梅克人与俄国挤压而分裂。
value.en: It split in the seventeenth century under Kalmyk and Russian pressure.

en: Moghulistan, also called the Moghul Khanate or the Eastern Chagatai Khanate, as a Turco-Mongol Muslim breakaway khanate of the Chagatai Khanate
Its location north of the Tengri Tagh range on the border of Central Asia and East Asia
Its area today including parts of Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and north-western China
zh: 蒙兀儿斯坦又称蒙兀儿汗国或东察合台汗国，是察合台汗国分裂出的突厥-蒙古穆斯林汗国
位于天山以北，处中亚与东亚交界
地域今包括哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦与中国西北部分地区

politics.zh: 蒙兀儿斯坦又称蒙兀儿汗国或东察合台汗国，是察合台汗国分裂出的突厥-蒙古穆斯林汗国，位于天山以北的中亚与东亚交界地带，地域今包括哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦与中国西北部分地区。汗国由察合台后裔统治，与帖木儿帝国、瓦剌及明朝长期交锋，16世纪后分裂为叶尔羌等地方政权。
politics.en: Moghulistan, also called the Moghul Khanate or the Eastern Chagatai Khanate, was a Turco-Mongol Muslim breakaway khanate of the Chagatai Khanate, lying north of the Tengri Tagh range on the border between Central Asia and East Asia, in an area that today includes parts of Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and north-western China. Ruled by descendants of Chagatai, it fought repeatedly with the Timurids, the Oirats and Ming China, and after the sixteenth century it divided into local states such as Yarkand.

economy.zh: 经济以天山南北的绿洲农业与草原畜牧为基础，控制丝绸之路中段的南北两道，商队贸易、牲畜与纺织品是主要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on oasis farming and steppe herding on both sides of the Tien Shan, and the khanate controlled the northern and southern routes of the middle Silk Road, with caravan trade, livestock and textiles as the main goods exchanged.

culture.zh: 蒙兀儿斯坦的突厥-蒙古统治层逐渐伊斯兰化并突厥化，察合台语文学在此发展，苏菲教团在绿洲城市传播，游牧传统与定居文化长期并存。
culture.en: The Turco-Mongol ruling group of Moghulistan gradually became Muslim and Turkicised, Chagatai literature developed there, Sufi orders spread in the oasis cities, and nomadic tradition long coexisted with settled culture. Its cities were also centres of manuscript production.

events.zh: 关键节点包括14世纪中期从察合台汗国分出、15世纪与帖木儿帝国的战争、16世纪的内部分裂，以及17世纪后为叶尔羌等政权取代。
events.en: Key moments are its separation from the Chagatai Khanate in the mid-fourteenth century, the wars with the Timurids in the fifteenth, internal division in the sixteenth and its replacement by states such as Yarkand after the seventeenth.

value.zh: 14世纪中期从察合台汗国分出。
value.en: It broke away from the Chagatai Khanate in the mid-fourteenth century.

value.zh: 16世纪后分裂为叶尔羌等地方政权。
value.en: After the sixteenth century it divided into local states such as Yarkand.

en: The Russian Empire as an empire extending across northern Eurasia from 1721 until the proclamation of the Russian Republic in 1917
Its formation as the final era of Tsarist Russia and the wider Russian monarchy
Its extent at its height in the late nineteenth century, about 22,800,000 square kilometres, roughly one-sixth of the world's land surface
zh: 俄罗斯帝国是1721至1917年俄罗斯共和国宣告成立前横跨欧亚北部的帝国
是沙皇俄国与俄罗斯君主制的最后阶段
19世纪末极盛时面积约2,280万平方公里，约占世界陆地的六分之一

politics.zh: 俄罗斯帝国是1721至1917年间横跨欧亚北部的帝国，由彼得一世在对瑞典的北方战争胜利后称帝开始，至1917年俄罗斯共和国宣告成立为止，是沙皇俄国与俄罗斯君主制的最后阶段。19世纪末极盛时面积约2,280万平方公里，约占世界陆地六分之一，由罗曼诺夫王朝统治，实行专制制度，1905年后设立国家杜马。
politics.en: The Russian Empire was an empire extending across northern Eurasia from 1721, when Peter I took the imperial title after victory over Sweden in the Great Northern War, until the proclamation of the Russian Republic in 1917, forming the final era of Tsarist Russia and the wider Russian monarchy. At its height in the late nineteenth century it covered about 22,800,000 square kilometres, roughly a sixth of the world's land surface, was ruled by the Romanov dynasty as an autocracy, and after 1905 had a state Duma.

economy.zh: 帝国经济以农业为主，19世纪后期工业化与铁路建设迅速推进，顿巴斯煤铁、巴库石油与纺织业是主要工业部门，谷物与木材是重要出口品，农奴制在1861年废除。
economy.en: The empire's economy was mainly agricultural, with industrialisation and railway building advancing rapidly in the later nineteenth century; coal and iron in the Donbas, oil at Baku and textiles were the main industries, grain and timber the leading exports, and serfdom was abolished in 1861.

culture.zh: 帝国境内民族与语言众多，俄罗斯东正教是国教，普希金、托尔斯泰与陀思妥耶夫斯基等人的文学享誉世界，科学院与大学体系在19世纪扩展，同时非俄罗斯民族的文化与语言受到压制。
culture.en: The empire contained many peoples and languages, Russian Orthodoxy was the state religion, the literature of Pushkin, Tolstoy and Dostoevsky became world famous, the academy and universities expanded in the nineteenth century, while the cultures and languages of non-Russian peoples were suppressed.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1721年彼得一世称帝、1861年废除农奴制、1905年革命与设立杜马、1914年参加第一次世界大战，以及1917年帝国崩溃。
events.en: Key moments are Peter I's assumption of the imperial title in 1721, the abolition of serfdom in 1861, the revolution of 1905 and the creation of the Duma, the entry into the First World War in 1914 and the collapse of the empire in 1917.

value.zh: 1721年彼得一世称帝，帝国建立。
value.en: Peter I took the imperial title in 1721, founding the empire.

value.zh: 19世纪末面积约2,280万平方公里。
value.en: At its height it covered about 22,800,000 square kilometres.

entries.titleZh: 高加索阿尔巴尼亚王国

en: Caucasian Albania as a modern exonym for a former state located in ancient times in the Caucasus, mostly overlapping present-day Azerbaijan
Its endonyms Aghwank and Aluank among the Udi people, who regard themselves as descended from its inhabitants
zh: 高加索阿尔巴尼亚是后人对古代高加索地区一个国家的称呼，地域大体相当于今阿塞拜疆
当地乌迪人称之为阿格万克或阿卢安克，并自认是其居民后裔

politics.zh: 高加索阿尔巴尼亚是后人对古代高加索地区一个国家的称呼，地域大体相当于今阿塞拜疆一带。“阿尔巴尼亚”一名源自希腊罗马地理学，当地乌迪人称之为阿格万克或阿卢安克并自认是其居民后裔。该国在古典时代与罗马、帕提亚及萨珊波斯周旋，4世纪皈依基督教，8世纪后在阿拉伯征服与伊斯兰化中逐渐消失。
politics.en: Caucasian Albania is a modern exonym for a former state located in ancient times in the Caucasus, mostly overlapping present-day Azerbaijan. The name comes from Greco-Roman geography, while the endonyms Aghwank and Aluank are used among the Udi people, who regard themselves as descended from its inhabitants. In classical antiquity the state manoeuvred between Rome, Parthia and Sassanid Persia, adopted Christianity in the fourth century and faded away after the Arab conquest and the spread of Islam in the eighth.

economy.zh: 该国位于库拉河下游与高加索山南麓，农业与畜牧业是经济基础，处在里海西岸与南高加索之间的商路上，丝绸、牲畜与农产品是主要交换物。
economy.en: The state lay on the lower Kura river and the southern slopes of the Caucasus, where farming and herding formed the economic base, and it stood on the routes between the western Caspian and the southern Caucasus, with silk, livestock and farm produce as the main goods exchanged.

culture.zh: 当地语言属东北高加索语系，字母与文献传统在基督教化后形成，教堂与考古遗址保留了其文化痕迹，乌迪人的语言与习俗是这一传统现存的一支。
culture.en: Its languages belonged to the Northeast Caucasian family, an alphabet and written tradition took shape after Christianisation, churches and archaeological sites preserve traces of its culture, and the language and customs of the Udi are a surviving branch of that tradition.

events.zh: 关键节点包括古典时代的建国、4世纪皈依基督教、5至6世纪与萨珊波斯的战争，以及8世纪阿拉伯征服后逐渐消失。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the state in classical antiquity, its conversion to Christianity in the fourth century, the wars with Sassanid Persia in the fifth and sixth and its gradual disappearance after the Arab conquest of the eighth century.

value.zh: 4世纪皈依基督教。
value.en: It adopted Christianity in the fourth century.

value.zh: 当地乌迪人称之为阿格万克或阿卢安克。
value.en: The endonyms among the Udi are Aghwank and Aluank.

en: Kamarupa, also called Pragjyotisha, as an early state during the classical period on the Indian subcontinent
Its place together with Davaka as the first historical kingdom of Assam
The first appearance of the word Kamarupa in the Samudragupta Allahabad edict
zh: 迦摩缕波又称普拉格乔蒂沙，是印度次大陆古典时期的早期国家
与达瓦卡并称阿萨姆历史上最早的王国
迦摩缕波一词最早见于沙摩陀罗笈多的阿拉哈巴德铭文

politics.zh: 迦摩缕波又称普拉革乔蒂沙，是印度次大陆古典时期的早期国家，位于布拉马普特拉河流域，与达瓦卡并称阿萨姆历史上最早的王国，其名称最早见于沙摩陀罗笈多的阿拉哈巴德铭文。王朝先后由弗尔曼、萨拉斯塔姆巴与帕拉等家族统治，与笈多、帕拉及当地部落政权互动，13世纪后为阿豪姆人的到来所取代。
politics.en: Kamarupa, also called Pragjyotisha, was an early state during the classical period on the Indian subcontinent, in the Brahmaputra valley, and together with Davaka it was the first historical kingdom of Assam; the word Kamarupa first appears in the Allahabad edict of Samudragupta. It was ruled in turn by the Varman, Salastambha and Pala families and interacted with the Guptas, the Palas and local tribal powers, until the arrival of the Ahoms in the thirteenth century changed the region for good.

economy.zh: 王国位于布拉马普特拉河谷，稻作农业与渔业是经济基础，处在通往西藏、缅甸与孟加拉的商路上，丝绸、木材与香料是主要交换物，河流是交通命脉。
economy.en: The kingdom lay in the Brahmaputra valley, where rice farming and fishing formed the economic base, and it stood on the routes towards Tibet, Burma and Bengal, with silk, timber and spices as the main goods exchanged, the rivers being the arteries of transport.

culture.zh: 迦摩缕波是印度教与佛教传统交汇的地区，神庙建筑与梵文铭文留下记录，地方语言与部落文化长期并存，后世阿萨姆的文学与宗教传统可追溯至此。
culture.en: Kamarupa was a meeting place of Hindu and Buddhist traditions, temple architecture and Sanskrit inscriptions record its history, local languages and tribal cultures long coexisted, and the later literary and religious traditions of Assam reach back to it.

events.zh: 关键节点包括4世纪前后弗尔曼王朝的建立、7世纪玄奘到访并记载其国、8至12世纪帕拉家族的统治，以及13世纪阿豪姆人的到来。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the Varman dynasty around the fourth century, the visit and account of the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang in the seventh, the rule of the Pala family in the eighth to twelfth centuries and the arrival of the Ahoms in the thirteenth.

value.zh: 名称最早见于沙摩陀罗笈多的阿拉哈巴德铭文。
value.en: The name first appears in the Allahabad edict of Samudragupta.

value.zh: 位于布拉马普特拉河流域。
value.en: It lay in the Brahmaputra valley.

en: In Greco-Roman geography, Iberia as an exonym for the Georgian kingdom of Kartli, known after its core province
Its existence during classical antiquity and the early Middle Ages, either as an independent state or as a dependency of larger empires, notably the Sassanids and Rome
Its centre in present-day eastern Georgia
zh: 在希腊罗马地理学中，伊比利亚是格鲁吉亚卡特利王国的外称，得名于其核心省份
存在于古典时代与中世纪早期，或为独立国家，或依附于萨珊波斯与罗马等大国
中心位于今格鲁吉亚东部

politics.zh: 在希腊罗马地理学中，伊比利亚是格鲁吉亚卡特利王国的外称，得名于其核心省份，中心位于今格鲁吉亚东部。王国存在于古典时代与中世纪早期，或为独立国家，或依附于萨珊波斯与罗马等大国，4世纪皈依基督教，此后长期在拜占庭与波斯之间周旋，8世纪后为阿拉伯统治与新的地方王朝取代。
politics.en: In Greco-Roman geography, Iberia was an exonym for the Georgian kingdom of Kartli, known after its core province, centred in what is now eastern Georgia. The kingdom existed during classical antiquity and the early Middle Ages, either as an independent state or as a dependency of larger empires, notably Sassanid Persia and Rome; it adopted Christianity in the fourth century, manoeuvred for centuries between Byzantium and Persia, and after the eighth century was replaced by Arab rule and new local dynasties.

economy.zh: 王国位于库拉河上游与高加索山南麓，农业与葡萄种植是经济基础，处在连接黑海与里海、高加索与波斯的商路上，过境贸易与手工业是重要收入来源。
economy.en: The kingdom lay on the upper Kura and the southern slopes of the Caucasus, where farming and viticulture formed the economic base, and it stood on the routes linking the Black and Caspian seas and the Caucasus with Persia, transit trade and crafts providing important income.

culture.zh: 王国是格鲁吉亚文字与基督教文化的发源地之一，4世纪基督教成为国教，教堂建筑与格鲁吉亚语铭文留下早期记录，与亚美尼亚及拜占庭文化互动密切。
culture.en: The kingdom was one of the birthplaces of Georgian writing and Christian culture: Christianity became the state religion in the fourth century, churches and Georgian inscriptions provide early records, and it interacted closely with Armenian and Byzantine culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括古典时代的建国、4世纪皈依基督教、5至6世纪与萨珊波斯的对抗，以及8世纪后为阿拉伯统治与地方王朝取代。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the kingdom in classical antiquity, its conversion to Christianity in the fourth century, the confrontations with Sassanid Persia in the fifth and sixth and its replacement by Arab rule and local dynasties after the eighth.

value.zh: 伊比利亚是希腊罗马地理学对卡特利王国的外称。
value.en: Iberia is the Greco-Roman exonym for the kingdom of Kartli.

value.zh: 4世纪皈依基督教。
value.en: It adopted Christianity in the fourth century.

en: The Soviet Union, officially the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, as a transcontinental country spanning much of Eurasia from 1922 to 1991
Its rank as the world's third-most populous country and the largest by area, bordering twelve other countries
Its character as a diverse multinational state
zh: 苏联正式称苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟，是1922至1991年横跨欧亚大陆的国家
是世界人口第三多、面积最大的国家，与十二个国家接壤
是多民族国家

politics.zh: 苏联正式称苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟，是1922至1991年间横跨欧亚大陆的国家，由俄罗斯、乌克兰、白俄罗斯及外高加索等苏维埃共和国联合成立，此后扩展到15个加盟共和国。它是世界面积最大、人口第三多的国家，与十二个国家接壤，由共产党一党执政，1991年解体为15个独立国家。
politics.en: The Soviet Union, officially the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, was a transcontinental country that spanned much of Eurasia from its formation in 1922 until its dissolution in 1991. Founded by the union of the Russian, Ukrainian, Belorussian and Transcaucasian soviet republics, it grew to fifteen union republics, was the largest country in the world by area and the third most populous, bordered twelve other countries, and was governed by a single communist party until it broke up into fifteen independent states in 1991.

economy.zh: 经济以国有制与中央计划为基础，重工业、军工与能源是重点部门，集体农庄经营农业，1928年起推行五年计划实现快速工业化，后期增长停滞与短缺问题突出。
economy.en: The economy rested on state ownership and central planning, with heavy industry, armaments and energy as priority sectors and collective farms running agriculture; five-year plans from 1928 brought rapid industrialisation, while stagnation and shortages became acute in the later decades.

culture.zh: 苏联推行普及教育与扫盲，科学、芭蕾与文学成就突出，俄罗斯语在联盟内广泛使用，各加盟共和国保留自己的语言与文化机构，同时受意识形态与审查制度约束。
culture.en: The Soviet Union carried out mass education and literacy campaigns, achieved notable results in science, ballet and literature, and used Russian widely across the union, while the republics kept their own languages and cultural institutions under ideological control and censorship.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1917年十月革命、1922年联盟成立、1928年起五年计划、1941至1945年卫国战争、1957年发射第一颗人造卫星，以及1991年解体。
events.en: Key moments are the October Revolution of 1917, the formation of the union in 1922, the five-year plans from 1928, the Great Patriotic War of 1941-1945, the launch of the first artificial satellite in 1957 and the dissolution of 1991.

value.zh: 1922年由多个苏维埃共和国联合成立。
value.en: It was formed in 1922 by the union of several soviet republics.

value.zh: 1991年解体为15个独立国家。
value.en: It broke up into fifteen independent states in 1991.
